config.reliable_remover.title: Reliable Remover Config
config.reliable_remover.option.show_remo: Shows a message above the hotbar when a restricted item is removed from your inventory.
config.reliable_remover.option.show_atta: Shows a message above the hotbar when trying to hit a mob using an item with attacks disabled.
config.reliable_remover.option.show_hand: Shows a message above the hotbar when trying to swing an item with hand swing disabled.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_cr: Hides restricted items from the Creative Mode menu.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_em: Hides restricted items from the EMI side panel.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_in: Removes restricted items from player inventories.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_dr: Instantly removes restricted items when they are dropped in the world.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_lo: Prevents restricted items from generating as loot.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_st: If enabled, banned items will be removed from Chests, Barrels, Shulker Boxes, etc. when the block inventory is opened.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_tr: Prevents restricted items from appearing in villager or wandering trader offers.
config.reliable_remover.option.blacklist: A list of item IDs that are completely removed from the game (e.g., minecraft:dirt). Syncs with EMI deletions.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_on: Automatically removes banned items when any inventory or container is opened.
message.reliable_remover.attack_disabled: Attacking with this item is disabled.
message.reliable_remover.swing_disabled: Swinging with this item is disabled.
config.reliable_remover.option.enable_em: Enable to delete items directly by hovering and pressing Delete in EMI.
config.reliable_remover.option.show_toas: Show a toast after removing an item through EMI.
config.reliable_remover.option.show_chat: Show chat feedback and UNDO buttons after removing an item through EMI.
config.reliable_remover.option.reload_em: Runs /reload immediately after an item is removed.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_in: Hides Information in JEI/EMI that feature restricted items.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_mo: Automatically removes restricted items from the hands or armor slots of mobs.
toast.reliable_remover.permission_denied: Reliable Remover: You need OP to delete items.
toast.reliable_remover.restored_item_fai: Could not restore item %s (not in cache or already exists)
